questions.prompt: The edit tool plugin is unloaded. What removes its advice from the next system prompt?
options: The model ignores advice for tools it no longer has
The disposer returned by register, which the plugin's effect runs on unload
The next section with a higher order number overwrites it
Nothing; the text stays until the session restarts
questions.explanation: register returns a function that deletes the section. Handing it to ctx.effect means it runs when the plugin unloads, so the next render no longer includes it.

questions.prompt: Two sections both have order 1000, named 'tool:grep' and 'tool:bash'. In what order are they rendered?
options: In the order they were registered
'tool:bash' first, because ties are broken by name
Only the later one, because the order collides
questions.explanation: render sorts by order, then by name. 'tool:bash' comes before 'tool:grep' alphabetically, and the result is the same on every run.

questions.prompt: Why are order numbers like 1000 and 1300 spaced apart instead of 1, 2, 3?
options: So a new section can take a slot between existing ones without renumbering the rest
Because the model reads larger numbers first
To limit each section to 300 characters
Because negative numbers are not allowed
questions.explanation: Gaps let a new tool claim order 1100 between bash and edit without changing any other plugin.
